full_prompt_en: A square loose oil landscape painting shows a white house on a narrow bank beside still blue water, framed by gold autumn trees. The sky behind the scene is a muted gray-blue wash with little distinct cloud detail. Near the center right, the house has a tall pale front wall, a dark sloping roof, and small narrow black windows. A side wall recedes toward the right, its cool blue-gray patches and warm ocher stains giving the white surface weathered variation. Two dark openings at ground level meet a strip of vivid yellow vegetation along the bank. On the left, a tree rises from a dark blue-violet trunk and crown, its upper foliage breaking into glowing yellow-orange flecks. Several slimmer trunks stand at the right of the house beneath another large gold canopy, making a loose vertical frame. The water fills the lower third, dark cobalt at the left and softer gray-blue near the center. A faint inverted reflection of the building and slender black marks lie within the surface, interrupted by horizontal ripples. The far waterline curves inward at left, leading the eye toward the house and an opening in the distant haze. Thick and thin paint coexist: quick bright dabs describe leaves and bank grasses, while broad cool strokes form water and sky. Light seems to arrive from behind the golden foliage, making the leaf clusters and shore glow while the lower trunks and water edge stay dark. A small dark signature-like mark appears at the lower right but is not clear enough to read. The overall composition is calm yet chromatically vivid, balancing a simple pale building against intense gold and deep blue reflections.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形松动油画风景呈现一座白色房屋立在平静蓝水旁的窄岸上，两侧由金黄秋树围住。场景后方天空是灰蓝色水洗，几乎没有边界清晰的云。中央偏右，房屋有高而浅色的正面墙、深色斜屋顶和小小狭长黑窗。一侧墙面向右后退，冷蓝灰斑块与暖赭色污痕使白墙带有风化变化。地面两道深色开口接着岸上一条鲜明黄色植被。左侧树从深蓝紫树干和枝冠上升，顶端叶子破碎为发亮的黄橘小点。房屋右侧几根更细的树干立在另一片大片金色树冠下，形成松散竖向框架。水占据下三分之一，左侧是深钴蓝，中央附近转为较柔的灰蓝。建筑的淡淡倒影和细黑痕迹落在水面，受水平涟漪打断。远处水线从左侧向内弯，引导视线通向房屋和朦胧远景的开口。厚薄颜料共存：迅捷亮色点涂描绘叶子和岸草，宽阔冷色笔触构成水与天空。光似乎从金色枝叶后方来，让叶簇和岸边发亮，下部树干及水边仍深暗。右下有小小深色签名般痕迹，但字形不足以辨读。整体构图平静却色彩鲜明，以简洁浅色房屋平衡强烈金黄和深蓝倒影。
style_prompt_en: The loose oil-painted surface contrasts saturated cobalt and blue-violet areas with concentrated gold and orange-yellow marks. Broad cool fields create a calm ground, while clustered warm dabs along upper and middle edges supply vivid rhythm. A pale central volume is lightly weathered with blue-gray and ocher scumbles, keeping it connected to the more freely painted surroundings. Outlines are incomplete; forms emerge where light and dark strokes meet, then dissolve at their less important edges. The lower zone carries vertical echoes and broken horizontal sweeps, creating reflection-like depth without exact detail. Light is diffused through the scene but appears strongest behind the warm clusters, leaving dark bases and narrow shadows beneath them. The composition has a clear central anchor, irregular vertical framing, and generous cool negative space. The overall effect is spontaneous and luminous, with material brushwork and complementary color contrast providing much of the energy.
style_prompt_zh: 松动油画表面把饱和钴蓝和蓝紫区域与集中的金色、橘黄色笔痕对照。宽阔冷色域形成平静底面，上部和中部边缘成簇暖色点涂提供鲜明节奏。中央浅色体量由蓝灰与赭色擦痕轻轻风化，使它仍与周围更自由的笔法相连。轮廓不完整；形体在明暗笔触相遇处浮现，再在不重要的边缘消散。下部区域带有竖向回声与破碎的横扫笔痕，形成倒映般纵深而无需精确细节。光在场景中漫散，却在暖色簇后方最强，使其底部和下方狭窄区域保持深暗。构图有清楚的中央锚点、不规则竖向围框和宽裕冷色负空间。整体效果自发而明亮，物质笔触与互补色反差提供大部分能量。
theme_en: A white riverside house between gold autumn trees
theme_zh: 金黄秋树之间的一座白色河边房屋
name: Pol Ledent
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
